narrador: Male storyteller in his late fifties, native speaker of Brazilian Portuguese with a natural accent from the interior of Brazil. Deep, warm, resonant low voice; calm, unhurried pace with expressive pauses, like a grandfather telling a folk legend by lamplight at night. Intimate, captivating and slightly mysterious.
tiao: Older Brazilian backwoods hunter around sixty, native Brazilian Portuguese with a rural caipira accent. Rough, gravelly, hoarse and loud voice; gruff, impatient and blunt, speaking forcefully.
ze: Young Brazilian man about twenty years old, native Brazilian Portuguese. Clear, bright tenor voice, slightly nervous and eager, natural lively pace.
vo: Elderly Brazilian grandmother around seventy-eight, a folk healer, native Brazilian Portuguese. Soft, sweet, slightly trembling aged voice but firm and authoritative; slow, wise, tender delivery.
curupira: Mischievous supernatural forest spirit with the voice of a small boy around nine years old, native Brazilian Portuguese. High-pitched, playful, sly and teasing, with a hint of eerie whisper.
